Spreadsheets · In development

Spreadsheet editor

Excel and Google Sheets, rebuilt for the browser.

Open now

Spreadsheets has these main features: 300+ functions, charts and pivot tables; Opens XLSX, ODS and CSV; saves XLSX and CSV. It opens Excel (.xlsx), OpenDocument spreadsheet (.ods), CSV, TSV.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.
